name: Hard Ops
what: The hub of the hard-surface workflow — booleans, bevels, mirroring, modifier management, and material/viewport helpers, all behind one menu.
when: Any destructive/boolean hard-surface work; managing the modifier stack.

name: BoxCutter
what: Draw-on-surface cutting. Sketch a shape and it becomes a live boolean cut, inset, or new object. Pairs with Hard Ops.
when: Fast carving of panels, slots, and shapes directly in the viewport.
notes: Tool active: <kbd>Ctrl</kbd>+<kbd>D</kbd> pie menu · <kbd>D</kbd> helper · <kbd>C</kbd> custom.

name: PUNCHit
what: Manifold inset + extrude — "punch" clean holes and recesses that stay watertight, without the boolean cleanup.
when: Insetting/extruding faces where you need manifold, fuse-ready geometry.

name: MESHmachine
what: Post-bevel surgery: rework chamfers and fillets after the fact, fuse/unfuse/refuse surfaces, flatten, normal-edit, and stamp on detail with the Plug library.
when: Fixing or reshaping bevels/fillets that a normal bevel can't handle.
notes: All tools live inside this one menu.

name: Edge Flow
what: Relaxes selected edges/loops to follow surrounding surface curvature (like Maya's Edit Edge Flow). Also sets edge/vertex curve.
when: Cleaning up edge loops so they flow smoothly across curved surfaces.

shortcuts.desc: Edge menu → Set Flow / Curve / Linear

notes: Also in the edit-mode <kbd class='mouse'>Right-click</kbd> context menu → Set Flow.

name: CURVEmachine
what: MESHmachine's little brother for curves — building and editing clean curve geometry for hard-surface detailing.
when: Cable runs, pipes, and curve-based detail work.

name: Curves to Mesh
what: Generates a clean quad surface that flows between two or more curves.
notes: While live: <kbd>Alt</kbd>+<kbd>↑↓←→</kbd> subdivisions · <kbd>Ctrl</kbd>+<kbd>R</kbd> refresh · <kbd>Shift</kbd>+<kbd>V</kbd> preview · <kbd>Alt</kbd>+<kbd>Enter</kbd> commit.

name: Construction Lines
what: CAD-style accurate modelling — work to exact dimensions with construction guides, snapping, and numeric input.
when: Anything that needs real-world measurements and precise constraints.

name: Grid Modeler
what: Draw shapes on an interactive grid to cut into or build out geometry, with precise grid snapping.
when: Greebles, panel detailing, and precise on-surface shapes.
notes: While live: <kbd>Q</kbd>/<kbd>Enter</kbd> confirm · <kbd>Ctrl</kbd>+<kbd class='mouse'>Scroll</kbd> resolution · <kbd>Alt</kbd>+<kbd class='mouse'>Scroll</kbd> extend grid · <kbd>W</kbd>/<kbd class='mouse'>RMB</kbd> switch mode · <kbd>Z</kbd> close shape · <kbd>X</kbd> from edge.

name: Mesh Align Plus
what: Align, move, and rotate geometry using points/lines/planes picked from the mesh itself — precise alignment without eyeballing.
when: Matching parts together exactly using existing geometry as reference.

name: Simple Bend
what: Bend geometry along an axis interactively, with angle/segment control.
when: Curving a straight object (pipes, brackets, signage) to a set angle.
notes: While live: <kbd>W</kbd> swap axis · <kbd>C</kbd> one side · <kbd>S</kbd> selected verts · <kbd>Shift</kbd> snap 5° · <kbd>Q</kbd> confirm.

name: MACHIN3tools
what: A large suite of quality-of-life tools and pie menus: Smart Vert/Edge/Face, Focus, Mirror, Group, customised pies, and Hard Ops / BoxCutter integration.
when: Everyday modelling speed-ups; ties the other tools together.

name: Quick Snap
what: Maya-style interactive vertex/point snapping — grab a point and snap it precisely onto another.
when: Precise point-to-point placement during edit/object mode.

name: Select Sim
what: Quickly select faces/edges similar to the current selection (by shape hash).
when: Grabbing all matching faces/edges in one step.

name: Mesh Copier
what: Copy mesh detail from a source edge-ring/face onto destination faces.
when: Reusing mesh detail across multiple surfaces.

name: Conform Object
what: Wrap / conform one object onto the surface of another.
when: Laying detail, decals-as-geometry, or panels onto a curved surface.

name: Just Panels
what: Generates panelling/greeble detail, with an accompanying asset pack.
notes: Install the addon zip; load JustPanels_ASSETS via Preferences → File Paths → Asset Libraries.

text: Shortcuts reflect the addons' default keymaps as verified in Blender 5.0 (no personal overrides). "Menu-only" tools register no keymap of their own — they live solely inside the listed menus.
